faq.title: Common Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the professional standard for the modern legal editor.

items.question: Who is Paperflow for?
items.answer: Paperflow is designed for legal professionals who manage complex, high-stakes documents. It is built for lawyers, counsel, and contract managers who need absolute control over their revision history.

items.question: Do you use my work to train AI?
items.answer: No. We do not use your legal text to train artificial intelligence models. Your work remains private and encrypted.

items.question: Is Microsoft Word supported?
items.answer: Yes. While you use Paperflow for internal versioning and branching, you can export to .docx at any time to share with outside parties or for final execution.

items.question: What platforms will be supported?
items.answer: Paperflow will launch initially as a web application optimized for desktop browsers. This allows us to deliver updates quickly to the legal community.

items.question: How do I get my data out?
items.answer: Data ownership is a core principle. You will be able to export individual documents or your entire repository to standard formats like Markdown, Docx, or PDF.

items.question: How is this different from 'Track Changes'?
items.answer: Track changes is for surface-level edits. Paperflow is for architectural version control, allowing you to branch off new ideas without cluttering the main agreement.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to use this?
items.answer: No. While the tech is powerful (based on Git), the interface is simple. We use concepts like 'Save Version' and 'Explore Wording' so you get the benefits without the complexity.

items.question: Is there a limit to how many versions I can save?
items.answer: We offer unlimited version history. We believe your history is a valuable legal asset that should never be deleted.

items.question: Is this just Git for lawyers?
items.answer: It shares the same philosophy as Git (branching, merging, history), but the interface and features are built specifically for the security and precision needs of the legal industry.

items.question: When can I start using Paperflow?
items.answer: Paperflow is currently in active development. Join the waitlist to secure your spot for the first legal beta release.
